study.title: Estimation of Kenaf seedling canopy coverage in saline soil using semantic segmentation of UAV RGB images

segmentation.domain: Binary semantic segmentation (Kenaf seedling vs saline-soil background) of high-resolution UAV RGB imagery for automated seedling identification and canopy-coverage estimation in saline-alkali fields; compares FCN, U-Net and DeepLabV3+, then enhances U-Net with a squeeze-excitation (SE) channel attention module (SE-UNet); canopy coverage from best segmentation correlated with dry bark yield to rank salt tolerance of 11 Kenaf varieties
segmentation.best_model: SE-UNet with AdamW optimizer: IoU 85.99%, Accuracy 92.92%, F1-score 92.44%, Precision 92.08%, Recall 92.92% (test). SE module gains +1.03 mIoU / +0.61 mF1 over plain U-Net (SGD); AdamW additionally +1.70 mIoU / +0.99 mF1 vs SGD. Best augmentation strategy ablation: photometric distortion (IoU 85.52 / F1 92.17) > geometric inversion (85.34 / 92.07) > scale change (85.08 / 91.91). U-Net baseline: IoU 84.29%, F1 91.45% (avg over classes); Kenaf-class IoU 81.3 (SE-UNet AdamW best overall)

dataset.name: Self-collected Kenaf (Hibiscus cannabinus L.) seedling UAV dataset from saline-alkali plots in Yancheng City, Jiangsu, China (soil pH 8.88-9.07, total water-soluble salts 0.12%-2.86%; plots 40 m x 1.4 m; 11 varieties: H368, Xiao 1-3, K1-K7). Acquired 9 July 2023 with a DJI Inspire 2 quadcopter + RGB camera (5472x3648 px) at 25 m, nadir (-90 deg), 6 m/s, 75% forward/side overlap (335 visible images; additional 1,734 multispectral frames via DJI Phantom 4 Multispectral for remote-sensing feature analysis); orthorectified in DJI Terra; cropped to 340x512 sub-images; 600 images randomly selected and manually annotated in LabelMe with binary Kenaf/background labels; 8:1:1 train/val/test split.
dataset.note: uav_collected=true. images=600 = annotated 340x512 sub-images (Image A); orthomosaic strips (Image B, 340x8880) used for full-field canopy coverage via sliding-window prediction. resolution_gsp_m=null: GSD not stated in the extracted text (flight altitude 25 m). Augmentation: 6-scale cropping to 512x512, flips (180 deg), photometric distortion (+-20% brightness, +-15% contrast); Test-Time Augmentation (multi-scale + horizontal flip) used at inference.

segmentation.backbone: U-Net encoder-decoder (skip connections) with squeeze-excitation (SE) channel attention at the end of each encoder stage; ResNet-101 backbone initialized with ImageNet weights; max iterations 40,000 (validate every 4,000); SGD (lr 2.5e-3, momentum 0.9, wd 5e-4) vs AdamW (lr 1e-4, wd 0.01), PolyLR decay; baselines FCN and DeepLabV3+ (ASPP) under the same unified protocol.

mIoU.quote: further improving model performance to achieve an IoU of 85.99% and an Dice of 92.44%
mIoU.ambiguity: Binary segmentation; the reported 'IoU' (average over the Kenaf and background classes) = mIoU. SE-UNet AdamW best (85.99%); SE-UNet SGD 85.32%; U-Net SGD 84.29%; DeepLabv3+ 82.52%; FCN 80.54%. Per-class IoU for U-Net: Kenaf 81.3 / Background 87.29. Test set (10% of 600 annotated images). Reported as percentage; stored as fraction.

mPA.ambiguity: Mean per-class pixel accuracy not reported; overall Accuracy (Acc) reported instead (recorded under PA).

F1.section: 4.3 / Table 4 (also abstract, where it is mislabeled 'Dice')
F1.ambiguity: F1-score column of Table 4 for SE-UNet AdamW (average over classes). The abstract calls the same value 'an Dice of 92.44%'; for binary segmentation F1 == Dice, recorded under F1. Ablations (Table 5): scale only 91.91, geometric 92.07, photometric 92.17.

Dice.ambiguity: The abstract labels the F1-score value (92.44%) as 'Dice'; the metrics tables report F1-score, so the value is recorded under F1 (binary F1 == Dice).

PA.quote: Replacing SGD with AdamW further enhanced SE-UNet's performance, achieving an overall mIoU improvement of 1.7%, accuracy gain of 1.01%, and mF1-score increase of 0.99%
PA.ambiguity: Overall Accuracy (Acc = (TP+TN)/(TP+TN+FP+FN)) for SE-UNet AdamW, 92.92%. SE-UNet SGD 92.55%; U-Net SGD 91.91% (per-class Acc U-Net: Kenaf 92.33 / Background 91.49).

weed_F1.ambiguity: Binary Kenaf-vs-background task; no crop/weed classes. Per-class IoU available for Kenaf (81.3 for U-Net) but no per-class F1 for a weed class.

crop_F1.ambiguity: Binary task (Kenaf plant = foreground vs soil background); no separate per-class crop F1 reported.

edge.device: None - offline experiments on a high-performance workstation (13th-gen Intel Core i5-13490F, 64 GB DDR4, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070; Python 3.8, CUDA 11.3, PyTorch 1.10). FCN noted as fastest inference for real-time/resource-limited applications, but no embedded deployment or inference FPS reported.
edge.framework: PyTorch 1.10 / CUDA 11.3 / Python 3.8 (Miniconda3); FCN/U-Net/DeepLabv3+/SE-UNet, ResNet-101 ImageNet init; 40,000 max iterations, SGD (lr 2.5e-3) or AdamW (lr 1e-4), PolyLR; inputs cropped/cropped-to-512x512 for training, sliding-window + TTA at inference

fps.ambiguity: No inference FPS reported. Table 3 lists 'data loading time' and 'model run time' (DeepLabv3+ 0.258/1.707, FCN 0.204/0.566, U-Net 0.244/0.653) but with unspecified units; not usable as inference latency. FCN qualitatively described as fastest.

latency_ms.ambiguity: No inference latency reported (Table 3 'model run time' units unspecified; qualitative only).

params_M.ambiguity: Parameter counts not reported (ResNet-101 backbone pretrained on ImageNet).

issues: The abstract labels the F1-score value (92.44%) as 'Dice'; the metrics tables (Tables 4-5) label it F1-score. Recorded under F1 (binary F1 == Dice); Dice left unreported with ambiguity.
uav_collected=true: authors collected the imagery (DJI Inspire 2 RGB; DJI Phantom 4 Multispectral also flown for remote-sensing feature analysis).
Binary Kenaf-vs-background segmentation; reported 'IoU' average over the two classes = mIoU. No weed/crop per-class F1.
edge.reported=false: workstation-only (RTX 4070); 'model run time' values have unspecified units and are not inference latency/FPS.
resolution_gsp_m=null: GSD not stated in the extracted text (flight altitude 25 m).
